subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh one of the open fork candidates or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this bug?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but the target-repository fix attempts are closed unmerged and the open fork candidates are conflict-marked, so automation should not open another fix branch until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repo fix
options.body: Queue or author one narrow Feishu plugin fix in this repository using the closed PRs as context and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better open fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new automated branch until a contributor refreshes a candidate with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repo fix
recommendation.body: Queue or author one narrow Feishu plugin fix in this repository using the closed PRs as context and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send/outbound history makes this the strongest available owner for choosing the implementation path.
